rationale.edition: The changed paths span both repos. Enterprise-owned locations are present: o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/llm_evaluations/annotation_queues.rs, eval_jobs/async_executor.rs and eval_jobs/tasks.rs (the o2-enterprise repo) plus web/src/enterprise/views/AIObservability/QueueWorkbenchPage.vue, web/src/enterprise/components/onlineEvals/utils/*. The OSS side carries the supporting layer: src/api/management/src/models/annotation_queues/mod.rs, src/config/src/config.rs (DB_SCHEMA_VERSION bump), the src/infra table entity + migration for llm_annotation_queue_items, web/src/services/llm-queues.service.ts, and the locale files. This is a linked OSS+ENT sister pair (the diff header explicitly notes openobserve/o2-enterprise #2678), so edition is 'both'.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The change is user-facing: the AI Observability Queue Workbench item navigator now displays a stored first-user-turn preview as the primary label and demotes the ref id to secondary text. The trigger comment and feature hint are both empty, and no tests-added/skip label was supplied, so there is no explicit opt-out.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. QueueWorkbenchPage.vue alters a user-exercisable UI flow — each item in the workbench list must render its input preview ahead of the id, fall back to the id when no preview was captured, and backfill the preview into the navigator when an older item is opened. That rendering and backfill behavior is exactly what a Playwright spec should verify against the enterprise build.
rationale.area: The UI changes live under web/src/enterprise/views/AIObservability/, but AI Observability has no dedicated Playwright area folder in the OSS base matrix. The enterprise overlay already groups comparable enterprise LLM features (e.g. model-pricing) under GeneralTests, and the deterministic registration step maps any spec whose folder is not a known OSS base folder onto GeneralTests, so that area is the consistent fit.
rationale.group: GeneralTests is the closest existing OSS base shard group. No AIObservability/LLM shard exists in the base ci_matrix.json, and GeneralTests is both the always-present fallback and the established home for enterprise LLM specs (model-pricing.spec.js lives there in the ENT overlay), so the new spec should join that group's run_files.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The only test files changed are Vitest unit/nav specs — web/src/enterprise/components/onlineEvals/utils/jobMappings.spec.ts, systemProvidedVariables.spec.ts, web/src/enterprise/views/AIObservability/QueueWorkbenchPage.nav.spec.ts, and web/src/services/llm-queues.service.spec.ts — none of which live under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/, so they provide no Playwright E2E coverage for the new preview behavior.
